settings.heading: Compliance made easy
settings.text: Businesses face the challenge of ensuring employees' compliance with safety regulations, especially in industries where alcohol consumption can pose risks. Andalink simplifies compliance monitoring by providing real-time data from Prodigy 3 and SoberLive FRX breathalysers, ensuring adherence to workplace safety protocols.

settings.heading: Real-time data management
settings.text: Managing and analysing alcohol testing data manually can be a time-consuming task for HR practitioners and OHS staff. Andalink streamlines this process by automating data collection and organisation, allowing personnel to focus on more strategic tasks rather than administrative burdens.

settings.heading: Risk mitigation
settings.text: Employers bear the responsibility of minimising risks associated with alcohol-related incidents in the workplace. Andalink empowers businesses to proactively address this challenge by offering a comprehensive platform for monitoring alcohol consumption patterns, identifying potential risks, and taking preventive measures to safeguard the well-being of employees and the organisation as a whole.

settings.heading: Keep employees accountable
settings.text: Ensuring accountability for alcohol consumption among employees is essential for maintaining a safe and productive work environment. Andalink facilitates this by establishing clear policies and protocols backed by data-driven insights from Prodigy 3 and SoberLive FRX breathalysers, fostering a culture of responsibility and trust within the organisation.

settings.heading: Prevent costly errors
settings.text: Alcohol-related incidents can result in significant financial losses for businesses due to legal fees, compensation claims, and reputational damage. Andalink acts as a proactive safeguard against such costly errors by providing accurate and timely data on employees' alcohol levels, enabling prompt intervention and risk mitigation strategies to prevent incidents before they occur.

settings.heading: Streamlined reporting
settings.text: Generating comprehensive reports for regulatory compliance or internal audits can be a tedious and labour-intensive process. Andalink simplifies this task by offering customisable reporting features that consolidate alcohol testing data into clear and actionable insights, helping businesses demonstrate compliance with industry standards and regulations effortlessly.

settings.heading: How does Andalink support my business?
settings.text:
Using Andalink, management personnel can oversee a comprehensive alcohol testing program that adapts to their business processes.

Whether your team works out of one location or over great distances, Andalink connects your workplace safety staff to frontline workers 24/7. Wall-mounted and portable compatible devices are available, meaning you can test any employee at any time.

Test data is collected by compatible testing devices and stored in the cloud, making it accessible from anywhere at any time.

settings.heading: What are the key features of Andalink?
settings.text:
Andalink supports your business' unique needs. Key features include:

  • Easy data analysis: Test results from multiple units are aggregated for easy viewing. CSV exports are available.
  • Employee records: Andalink compatible units use facial recognition to index test results in real time.
  • Secure data storage: Data is stored using cloud technology. It can be access remotely using secure servers.
  • Dedicated support: Clients are assigned a dedicated account manager to ensure smooth deployment and ongoing support.
  • Customised notifications and alerts: managers can be notified via email when a breath test exceeds designated limits.

settings.heading: Which devices are compatible with Andalink?
settings.text:
Two different devices are currently compatible with Andalink. Both are Australian Standards-certified for accuracy and can be paired as needed to support your specific business needs.

Andatech Prodigy 3 is an industry-leading portable breathalyser. It's ideal for use when your workforce operates from many worksites across a large geographic area.

Andatech Soberlive FRX is a wall-mounted breathalyser. It is ideal for use at dedicated worksites and can also be used as a timesheet manager and to control door access, among other features.
